Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Kansas City hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 16 Kansas City hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, trivago DEALS at 3, Hotels.com at 1, NO VACANCY at 1, Stayforlong.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Kansas City rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Kansas City hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 8% at Hotel No Vacancy® to 22% at Best Western Plus Kansas City Sports Complex Hotel. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
